cases.name: failed_start_recent
cases.description: A start that failed three hours ago is open and needs the owner: a retry ask on the to-do, the stored error on line 2, and 48 hours after the failure it moves on.

cases.name: failed_start_after_two_days
cases.description: 48 hours after a start failed, with nothing done to the to-do since, it is a To do with the Inactive mark, never Done, though done_at is stored.

cases.name: failed_start_edited_since
cases.description: The owner edited a failed start's notes the day after it failed. Its 48 hours in Needs you run from the failure, so it is a To do now; the edit is activity, so the Inactive mark waits until 48 hours after it.
